big_case.notes: A presidential emergency application, argued by the Solicitor General, to stay an injunction against an executive order restructuring federal election administration weeks before the 2026 midterms, opposed by a multistate bloc led by California, with a same-day call for a response, thirteen amicus filings at the application stage, supplemental briefing, and a full-Court grant. Near the ceiling of interim-docket stakes.
